Meet the people at school

Magic games for Age 3

Two gentle games for preschoolers, each wired to its class: look and draw magic shapes, and play at the animal playground. No scores, no timers, nothing to install.

Everything on this shelf comes from something your child really did — a class finished, a game played, a picture saved. Nothing here is a score, and nothing is shared anywhere: it is your room, on your device.
